quotations.old_english: Ðonne þū cuglan habban wylle, þonne wege þū þīnne earmellan and fōh tō þīnum hōde
Nim þū þē be þīnum bode
Gif hē godspel ræde lecge him þæne hōd ofer þā sculdra
quotations.latin: si evangelium legit, cucullum vel cappam super humeros dejiciat

source_text: h&o-long;d. For ' Cot. 31, Lye' substitute :-- Hood capitium, Wrt. Voc. ii. 102, 65. H&o-long;d, 128, 49: 13, 22. Ðonne þ&u-long; cuglan habban wylle, þonne wege þ&u-long; þ&i-long;nne earmellan and f&o-long;h t&o-long; þ&i-long;num h&o-long;de, Tech. ii. 127, 17. Nim þ&u-long; þ&e-long; be þ&i-long;num bode, 129, 4. Gif h&e-long; godspel ræ-long;de lecge him þæne h&o-long;d ofer þ&a-long; sculdra si evangelium legit, cucullum vel cappam super humeros dejiciat, Ll. Th. ii. 140, 25.
